hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git +push.*( --force( |$)| -f( |$))|git +reset +--hard|git +clean +-[a-zA-Z]*f|rm +-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|rm +-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*r'; then echo 'Blocked by guardrail: destructive command. Run it yourself if you really mean it.' >&2; exit 2; fi
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.md) [ -f "$f" ] && npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
